f.title: MAH keeps full responsibility for the PV system when using a CPVSO
f.statement: Under the Regulation on the Safety of Medicinal Products, the MAH may carry out all or part of its pharmacovigilance duties through a CPVSO, but all responsibility for the complete and correct functioning of the pharmacovigilance system always remains with the MAH.
f.clause: Article 2 Scope
f.legal_basis: Regulation on the Safety of Medicinal Products

rows.quote: İlaçların Güvenliliği Hakkında Yönetmelik’te ruhsat sahibinin farmakovijilans ile ilgili görevlerinin tamamını ya da bir kısmını SFHK vasıtasıyla yürütebileceği belirtilmiş, ancak farmakovijilans sisteminin tam ve doğru olarak işlemesine ilişkin tüm sorumlulukların her zaman ruhsat sahibine ait olduğu vurgulanmıştır.
rows.location: Article 2 Scope
rows.review_note: Review: Added; restates the Regulation (MAH keeps all responsibility), missed by extractor. Wording "vurgulanmıştır" reports the Regulation; level Mandatory follows the Regulation. Double-check: below 90: "vurgulanmıştır" reports the Regulation rather than imposing a duty in this text; Mandatory follows the Regulation (no article cited); statement mixes the permission to delegate with retained responsibility. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The Regulation on the Safety of Medicinal Products states that the marketing authorisation holder may carry out all or part of its pharmacovigilance duties through a CPVSO, but emphasises that all responsibility for the complete and correct functioning of the pharmacovigilance system always lies with the marketing authorisation holder.

f.title: MAHs running PV in-house must meet the minimum CPVSO requirements
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders that carry out their pharmacovigilance obligations in-house must also meet the minimum requirements set for contract pharmacovigilance service organisations.
f.clause: Article 2 Scope

rows.quote: Farmakovijilans yükümlülüklerini kendi bünyesinde yürüten ruhsat sahiplerinin de SFHK’larda bulunması gereken asgari şartları sağlaması gerekmektedir.
rows.location: Article 2 Scope
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves level, actor and statement. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders that carry out their pharmacovigilance obligations in-house must also meet the minimum requirements that CPVSOs must meet.

f.title: CPVSO: written delegation, full-time QPPV and deputy, TITCK-inspected approval
f.statement: A CPVSO is an organisation to which the MAH delegates all or part of its PV duties, provided this is set down in writing; it employs at least one person full-time as QPPV and one as deputy QPPV, meets the conditions of this guideline, and has been inspected and approved by TITCK.
f.clause: Article 4(1)(h) Definitions

rows.quote: Sözleşmeli Farmakovijilans Hizmet Kuruluşu: Ruhsat sahibinin farmakovijilansla ilgili görevlerinin tümünü veya bir kısmını yazılı olarak belirlemek kaydı ile devrettiği, en az bir kişiyi farmakovijilans yetkilisi ve bir kişiyi de onun vekili olarak tam zamanlı istihdam eden, bu kılavuzda belirtilen şartları haiz ve Kurumca denetlenerek onaylanmış kuruluşu,
rows.location: Article 4(1)(h) Definitions
rows.review_note: Review: Added; definition carries binding conditions (written delegation, full-time QPPV and deputy, TITCK inspection/approval). Definition-based; double-check level. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Contract Pharmacovigilance Service Organisation: means the organisation to which the marketing authorisation holder has delegated all or part of its pharmacovigilance duties, on condition that this is set down in writing, which employs full-time at least one person as pharmacovigilance officer and one person as his/her deputy, meets the conditions set out in this guideline, and has been inspected and approved by the Agency,

f.title: Employ sufficient PV staff and scale staff and equipment with workload
f.statement: The MAH and the CPVSO must employ sufficient staff in proportion to the workload and, when the number of medicinal products under their responsibility increases, increase staff numbers and equipment in proportion to the work volume.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a) Adequately equipped and sufficient staff

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibi ve SFHK iş yüküyle doğru orantılı olarak yeterli sayıda personel istihdam etmek, sorumluluğu altındaki tıbbi ürünlerin sayısının artması durumunda, personel sayısı ve donanım büyüklüğünü¸ iş hacmi ile orantılı şekilde artırmakla yükümlüdür.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a) Adequately equipped and sufficient staff
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves level, actor and statement. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder and the CPVSO are obliged to employ a sufficient number of staff in direct proportion to the workload and, where the number of medicinal products under their responsibility increases, to increase the number of staff and the size of equipment in proportion to the work volume.

f.title: Ensure QPPV and deputy are trained, experienced and continuously in place
f.statement: The QPPV and the deputy are the key PV personnel; they must receive the required training, have sufficient experience, and their continuity must be ensured.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: Farmakovijilans çalışmalarında kilit personel farmakovijilans yetkilisi ve vekilidir. Bu pozisyonlarda çalışan personellerin gerekli eğitimleri alması, yeterli deneyime sahip olması ve sürekliliğinin sağlanması gerekmektedir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive wording, actor (MAH and/or CPVSO) inferred rather than named in the quote. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The key personnel in pharmacovigilance work are the pharmacovigilance officer and the deputy. Staff working in these positions must receive the necessary training and have sufficient experience, and their continuity must be ensured.

f.title: Complete the first TITCK training programme after appointment
f.statement: After appointment, the QPPV and the deputy must attend and successfully complete the first training programme organised by TITCK; those who do not attend without submitting an excuse to TITCK may not continue their duties until they complete this training.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(i) Training of the QPPV and deputy
f.exceptions: Non-attendance with an excuse submitted to TITCK

rows.deadline: First TITCK training programme held after appointment
rows.quote: Farmakovijilans yetkilisi ve vekili; atanmasından sonra Kurum tarafından düzenlenen ilk eğitim programına katılmak ve başarıyla tamamlamak zorundadır. Kuruma mazeret sunulmadan söz konusu eğitime katılmayanlar bu eğitimi tamamlayıncaya kadar görevlerine devam edemezler.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(i) Training of the QPPV and deputy
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves level, actor and statement. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The pharmacovigilance officer and the deputy are required to attend and successfully complete the first training programme organised by the Agency after their appointment. Those who do not attend this training without submitting an excuse to the Agency may not continue their duties until they complete this training.

f.title: Complete basic MedDRA MSSO coding training within six months of appointment
f.statement: The QPPV and deputy must take the basic MedDRA coding training organised by the MedDRA MSSO (Coding with MedDRA, Safety Data Analysis and Standardised MedDRA Queries [SMQs]) within six months at the latest following appointment.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(i) Training of the QPPV and deputy

rows.deadline: Within six months of appointment at the latest
rows.quote: MedDRA MSSO tarafından düzenlenen temel MedDRA kodlama eğitimini (Coding with MedDRA, Safety Data Analysis and Standardised MedDRA Queries [SMQs]) atama yapılmasını takiben en geç altı ay içerisinde almak zorundadır.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(i) Training of the QPPV and deputy
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: quote continues the QPPV training paragraph and does not repeat its subject (QPPV and deputy named in 0004). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: [They] are required to take the basic MedDRA coding training organised by the MedDRA MSSO (Coding with MedDRA, Safety Data Analysis and Standardised MedDRA Queries [SMQs]) within six months at the latest following appointment.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Basic MedDRA coding training of the QPPV and deputy after appointment

f.title: Follow other MedDRA MSSO trainings and document them
f.statement: The QPPV and deputy should follow other face-to-face or online MedDRA MSSO trainings (such as Let's Code Together, Advanced MedDRA Coding), take all current trainings and document that they have taken them.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(i) Training of the QPPV and deputy

rows.quote: MedDRA MSSO tarafından düzenlenen yüz yüze ya da çevrim içi diğer eğitimleri de (Let’s Code Together, Advanced MedDRA Coding gibi) takip ederek tüm güncel eğitimleri almalı ve bu eğitimleri aldığını belgelemelidir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(i) Training of the QPPV and deputy
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: quote continues the QPPV training paragraph and does not repeat its subject (QPPV and deputy named in 0004). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: [They] should also follow the other face-to-face or online trainings organised by the MedDRA MSSO (such as Let's Code Together, Advanced MedDRA Coding), take all current trainings, and document that they have taken these trainings.

f.title: Take and document training for other PV tasks
f.statement: For their other duties (such as adverse reaction reporting, PBRER and RMP preparation) the QPPV and deputy should follow face-to-face or online trainings and document that they have taken them.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(i) Training of the QPPV and deputy

rows.quote: Yürüteceği diğer görevler için de (advers reaksiyon bildirimi, PYRDR, RYP hazırlama gibi) yüz yüze veya çevrim içi olarak verilen eğitimleri takip ederek bu eğitimleri almalı ve bu eğitimleri aldığını belgelemelidir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(i) Training of the QPPV and deputy
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: quote continues the QPPV training paragraph and does not repeat its subject (QPPV and deputy named in 0004). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For the other duties they will carry out (such as adverse reaction reporting, preparation of PBRERs and RMPs) [they] should also follow the trainings given face-to-face or online, take these trainings and document that they have taken them.

f.title: Attend TITCK training after major PV legislation changes and update certificate
f.statement: When there are significant changes in pharmacovigilance legislation (such as regulation or guideline updates changing current practice, or publication of new GVP guidelines), the QPPV and deputy should attend the training organised by TITCK and update their training certificate.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(i) Training of the QPPV and deputy

rows.quote: Farmakovijilans mevzuatında önemli değişiklikler olduğunda (Mevcut uygulamaları değiştiren yönetmelik, kılavuz güncellemeleri, yeni İFU kılavuzlarının yayınlanması gibi) Kurum tarafından düzenlenen eğitime katılarak eğitim belgesini güncellemelidir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(i) Training of the QPPV and deputy
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: quote continues the QPPV training paragraph and does not repeat its subject (QPPV and deputy named in 0004). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When there are significant changes in pharmacovigilance legislation (such as regulation or guideline updates that change current practice, or publication of new GVP guidelines), [they] should attend the training organised by the Agency and update their training certificate.

f.title: Document at least one year of PV experience before acting as QPPV
f.statement: To serve as QPPV, it must be documented that the person has worked in the pharmacovigilance field for at least one year.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(ii) Experience

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: Farmakovijilans yetkilisi olarak görev yapabilmek için farmakovijilans alanında en az bir yıl çalışmış olduğunun belgelenmesi gerekmektedir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(ii) Experience
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive wording, actor (MAH and/or CPVSO) inferred rather than named in the quote. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: To serve as pharmacovigilance officer, it must be documented that the person has worked in the field of pharmacovigilance for at least one year.

f.title: QPPV may cover up to 150 (MAH) or 100 (CPVSO) active substances, +10% at most
f.statement: A QPPV working within an MAH may be responsible for the pharmacovigilance activities of up to 150 active substances, and a QPPV working at a CPVSO for up to 100 active substances. The number of active substances a QPPV is responsible for may be increased by at most 10% of the upper limit.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibi bünyesinde görev yapan farmakovijilans yetkilisi 150 etkin maddenin, SFHK’da görev yapan farmakovijilans yetkilisi 100 etkin maddenin farmakovijilans faaliyetlerinden sorumlu olabilir. Yetkililerin sorumlu olduğu etkin madde sayısı üst limitin en fazla %10’u oranında artırılabilir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload
rows.review_note: Review: Level changed Permitted -> Mandatory. Turkish modal is permissive ("sorumlu olabilir", "artırılabilir"), but the next sentence calls the figures "üst limit" and allows an increase of "en fazla %10"; the provision's effect is a binding cap (revision history: limits "güncellendi"). Statement reworded as cap; 165/110 is arithmetic, not in source. Double-check: below 90: Mandatory is an SME judgement: the Turkish verbs are permissive ("sorumlu olabilir", "artırılabilir") and the cap effect comes from "üst limit" / "en fazla %10". Removed the derived figures 165/110 from the statement (arithmetic not in the quote). Bilingual pass: level kept Mandatory although the verbs are '-ebilir' (may): the sentence sets an upper limit (150/100 active substances, at most +10%), so exceeding it is not permitted. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level changed Mandatory -> Permitted: the only modals are "olabilir"/"artırılabilir" (-ebilir) and the quote carries no binding form or cited article; the cap reading stays in the statement; below 90 as the level rests on a judgement call.
rows.quote_en: A pharmacovigilance officer working within a marketing authorisation holder may be responsible for the pharmacovigilance activities of 150 active substances, and a pharmacovigilance officer working at a CPVSO for those of 100 active substances. The number of active substances for which officers are responsible may be increased by at most 10% of the upper limit.

f.title: Keep current records of active substances per QPPV and submit on request
f.statement: The active substances for which the QPPV is responsible must be identified, up-to-date records kept with the dates on which responsibility started for each active substance, and these submitted immediately on TITCK request.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: Farmakovijilans yetkilisinin sorumlu olduğu etkin maddelerin belirlenmesi, etkin madde bazında sorumluluğun başladığı tarihlerle birlikte güncel kayıtların tutulması ve Kurumun talebi halinde derhal sunulması gerekmektedir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive wording, actor (MAH and/or CPVSO) inferred rather than named in the quote. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The active substances for which the pharmacovigilance officer is responsible must be identified, up-to-date records must be kept together with the dates on which responsibility started for each active substance, and these must be submitted immediately upon request of the Agency.

f.title: Allocate active substances to QPPVs by therapeutic area
f.statement: When allocating active substances, a distribution of duties according to the therapeutic areas of the medicinal products is recommended.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: Etkin maddeler belirlenirken ilaçların terapötik alanlarına göre bir görev dağılımı yapılması tavsiye edilmektedir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: "tavsiye edilmektedir" passive, actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When the active substances are allocated, it is recommended that duties are distributed according to the therapeutic areas of the medicines.

f.title: Count the same active substance for different MAHs separately at a CPVSO
f.statement: Where a CPVSO serves different MAHs for the same active substance, each is evaluated as a different active substance and the 100-active-substance calculation is made accordingly.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload

rows.quote: SFHK’larda aynı etkin madde için farklı ruhsat sahiplerine hizmet verilmesi durumunda farklı etkin madde gibi değerlendirilerek 100 etkin madde hesabı buna göre yapılır.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload
rows.review_note: Review: Mandatory confirmed (prescriptive present "yapılır"). Double-check: below 90: prescriptive present "yapılır" read as Mandatory; calculation rule rather than a stated duty. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Where a CPVSO serves different marketing authorisation holders for the same active substance, this is counted as different active substances, and the 100-active-substance calculation is made accordingly.

f.title: CPVSO QPPV may not act as deputy QPPV for another company
f.statement: A person serving as QPPV at a CPVSO may not serve as deputy QPPV of another company. However, where different MAHs under the same parent company run a common PV system, the QPPV of one MAH may serve as deputy QPPV of another company in the same group.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload
f.exceptions: Different MAHs under the same parent company operating a common PV system

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: SFHK’da farmakovijilans yetkilisi olarak görev yapan kişi başka bir firmanın farmakovijilans yetkilisi vekili olarak görev yapamaz. Ancak, ana ortaklık çatısı altında faaliyet gösteren farklı ruhsat sahiplerinin ortak bir farmakovijilans sistemi yürütmeleri halinde bir ruhsat sahibinin farmakovijilans yetkilisi olarak görev yapan kişi aynı ortaklık çatısındaki diğer firmanın farmakovijilans yetkilisi vekili olarak görev yapabilir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload
rows.review_note: Review: Mandatory confirmed ("görev yapamaz" = may not; exception "yapabilir" kept in exceptions). Double-check: below 90: restriction phrased on the person; MAH/CPVSO actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: A person serving as pharmacovigilance officer at a CPVSO may not serve as deputy pharmacovigilance officer of another company. However, where different marketing authorisation holders operating under the umbrella of a parent company run a common pharmacovigilance system, the person serving as pharmacovigilance officer of one marketing authorisation holder may serve as deputy pharmacovigilance officer of another company under the same group umbrella.

f.title: Deputy QPPV may be assigned to at most two QPPVs
f.statement: A deputy QPPV may be assigned as deputy to at most two QPPVs (cap).
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: Farmakovijilans yetkilisi vekilleri en fazla iki farmakovijilans yetkilisinin vekili olarak görevlendirilebilir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iii) Workload
rows.review_note: Review: Level changed Permitted -> Mandatory: "görevlendirilebilir" is permissive but qualified by "en fazla iki" (at most two), so the binding content is a cap. Double-check: below 90: Mandatory cap read from "en fazla iki" although the verb "görevlendirilebilir" is permissive (-ebilir = Permitted on a literal mapping); SME judgement. Bilingual pass: level kept Mandatory although the verb is '-ebilir' (may): 'en fazla iki' sets a cap of two, so a third assignment is not permitted. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees; level changed Mandatory -> Permitted: only modal is "görevlendirilebilir" (-ebilir), no binding form or cited article; "en fazla iki" cap kept in the statement; below 90 (judgement call).
rows.quote_en: Deputy pharmacovigilance officers may be assigned as deputy to at most two pharmacovigilance officers.

f.title: Ensure QPPV and deputy are known and reachable by all company staff
f.statement: To raise awareness and ensure timely and appropriate transmission of adverse reaction reports, it must be ensured that the QPPV and deputy are recognised, known and reachable by everyone working at the company for which they are responsible, such as call-centre, security and production staff.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iv) Recognisability and accessibility

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: Advers reaksiyon bildirimlerinin artırılması için farkındalığın sağlanması, bildirimlerin zamanında ve uygun şekilde iletilmesi amacıyla farmakovijilans yetkilisi ve vekilinin farmakovijilans faaliyetlerinden sorumlu olduğu firmanın çağrı merkezi personeli, güvenlik personeli, üretim personeli gibi çalışan herkes tarafından tanınır, bilinir ve ulaşılabilir olmasının sağlanması gerekmektedir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(a)(iv) Recognisability and accessibility
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive wording; who must ensure recognisability is inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In order to raise awareness so as to increase adverse reaction reporting, and to ensure that reports are transmitted in a timely and appropriate manner, it must be ensured that the pharmacovigilance officer and the deputy are recognised, known and reachable by everyone working at the company for whose pharmacovigilance activities they are responsible, such as call-centre staff, security staff and production staff.

f.title: Provide suitable premises, technical equipment, IT systems and archive
f.statement: Premises suitable for carrying out PV activities and sufficient technical equipment (such as IT systems and an (electronic) archive) are required.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(b) Suitable working environment

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: Farmakovijilans faaliyetlerini yürütmeye elverişli mekâna, yeterli teknik donanıma, ekipmana sahip olunması (bilgi teknoloji (IT) sistemleri ve (elektronik) arşiv gibi) gerekir.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(b) Suitable working environment
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive wording, actor (MAH and/or CPVSO) inferred rather than named in the quote. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Premises suitable for carrying out pharmacovigilance activities, and sufficient technical equipment and apparatus (such as information technology (IT) systems and an (electronic) archive), are required.

f.title: Maintain a controlled physical archive with locked cabinets and climate logs
f.statement: A CPVSO should have a physical archive sized for the number of companies it serves, with locked stainless-steel cabinets allocated per company; access should be restricted to authorised persons; archive entries and exits should be tracked and recorded; temperature and humidity of the physical archive should be recorded by devices in a way that can be transferred online.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(b) Suitable working environment

rows.quote: SFHK’nın farmakovijilans yükümlülüklerini yürüttüğü firma sayısı ile uyumlu olacak büyüklükte fiziksel arşivi bulunmalıdır. Bu arşivde her firma için belirlenen kilitli paslanmaz çelik dolaplar yer almalıdır. Arşive erişim yalnızca yetkili kişiler ile sınırlandırılmalıdır. Arşiv giriş-çıkışlarının etkin takibi yapılarak kayıt altına alınmalıdır. Fiziksel arşivin ısı ve nem kayıtları çevrim-içi ortama aktarılabilecek şekilde, cihazlar ile kayıt altına alınmalıdır.
rows.location: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(b) Suitable working environment
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves level, actor and statement. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The CPVSO should have a physical archive of a size consistent with the number of companies for which it carries out pharmacovigilance obligations. This archive should contain locked stainless-steel cabinets designated for each company. Access to the archive should be restricted to authorised persons only. Entries to and exits from the archive should be effectively tracked and recorded. Temperature and humidity records of the physical archive should be recorded by devices in a way that can be transferred to an online environment.

f.title: Store documents electronically if the system is validated and secured
f.statement: Documents may be stored in electronic format provided the electronic system is appropriately validated and has appropriate arrangements for system security, access and back-up.
f.clause: Article 5 Minimum requirements for MAHs and CPVSOs(1)(b) Suitable working environment
f.exceptions: Only if the electronic system is validated and has appropriate security, access and back-up arrangements

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: Elektronik sistemin uygun şekilde valide edilmesi ve sistem güvenliği, erişim ve yedekleme açısından uygun düzenlemelere sahip olması şartıyla, belgeler elektronik formatta saklanabilir.

f.statement: All printed and electronic information within the scope of information security must be managed according to the principles of confidentiality (protection from unauthorised access), integrity (no modification by unauthorised staff) and availability (accessible and usable by authorised staff when needed).

f.title: Apply information security standards, manage risks and train all users
f.statement: Information security standards must be met, all relevant legislation complied with, risks to information assets identified and managed, the information security system continuously reviewed with necessary measures taken, and all users with access to information (staff of the MAH, CPVSO and third parties running controlled access programmes, part-time staff, business partners' and supporting firms' staff) made aware.

f.title: Inform staff and contractors before hiring of confidentiality agreements and set out security duties
f.statement: Before hiring, all staff and contractors are informed that personal and/or corporate confidentiality agreements will be signed; the content of the agreements and the obligations of those concerned are explained in detail, and the agreements clearly state the information security responsibilities of individuals and the administration.

f.title: Maintain indefinite secrecy and complete leaver security processes
f.statement: A person is responsible for keeping information obtained during their duty secret, even after changing post or leaving, and never disclosing it without authorisation; the secrecy obligation is indefinite. Leaving procedures of departing or reassigned staff are completed fully from an information security perspective.

f.statement: Where data must be transferred to another CPVSO, after the transfer the firm with which the MAH was previously contracted performs a "secure delete" on all PV data, destroys the hard disks holding the data by appropriate methods, and hands over printed documents to the MAH with signed minutes without modification or copying. f.title: Staff are liable for breaches and use information only for their duties
f.statement: Staff are responsible for any damage to the CPVSO, the MAH and third parties if they personally breach information security; they use information entrusted to them only for duty-related work, protect it as their own confidential information and share it with no one other than authorised persons who need to know; and, unless specially authorised, they do not share information with any unauthorised person, including officials of the parties served.

Bu bilgileri kendi gizli bilgisi gibi korur ve bilmesi gereken yetkili kişiler haricinde hiçbir kimse ile paylaşmaz. c) Personel, özel olarak yetkilendirildiği durumlar dışında, hizmet verilen tarafların yetkilileri de dâhil olmak üzere yetkisi olmayan hiçbir kişi ile bilgi paylaşımı yapmaz.

They protect this information as their own confidential information and do not share it with anyone other than authorised persons who need to know. c) Except where specifically authorised, staff do not share information with any unauthorised person, including officials of the parties served.

f.title: Staff must not exploit, disclose or unlawfully alter information
f.statement: Staff may not use information obtained for the benefit of any person, group or organisation; must keep all confidential information secret and never pass it to third parties, an obligation continuing after the employment relationship ends; and may not attempt to unlawfully seize, change or delete programs, data or other elements of information systems, nor transfer or copy them.

Bu yükümlülük, personelin görev yaptığı kurum ile ilişkisinin sona ermesi halinde de devam eder. e) Personel, bilgi sistemlerinde kullanılan/yer alan programları, verileri veya diğer unsurları hukuka aykırı olarak ele geçirme, değiştirme, silme girişiminde bulunamaz ve bunları nakledemez veya çoğaltamaz.

rows.quote_en: Staff may not use the information they obtain for the benefit of any person, group, institution or organisation. d) Staff are obliged to keep secret all confidential information they obtain, whether or not related to their duties, and not to pass it on to third parties in any way. This obligation continues after the end of the staff member's relationship with the institution where he/she works. e) Staff may not attempt to unlawfully seize, change or delete programs, data or other elements used in or contained in information systems, and may not transfer or copy them.

f.title: Staff must not damage systems or copy or transfer data without authorisation
f.statement: Staff may not destroy, change or delete information processing environments or stored data in whole or part, obstruct or corrupt system operation, whether to harm others, gain unfair advantage or without any purpose; and may not use, copy, move or transfer information or data obtained in their duty without authorisation and permission for any purpose.

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibi ve SFHK arasında yapılan anlaşmada her şey açık ve net olarak yazılmalı, devredilen görev ve sorumluluklar net olarak belirtilmeli, hiçbir konu muallakta bırakılmamalıdır. Anlaşma, her iki tarafın hukukçuları tarafından gözden geçirilerek onayları alınmalıdır.
rows.location: Article 7(2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: actors named; "-meli" Recommended. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In the agreement made between the marketing authorisation holder and the CPVSO, everything should be written clearly and precisely, the delegated duties and responsibilities should be stated precisely, and no matter should be left unresolved. The agreement should be reviewed by the lawyers of both parties and their approval obtained.

f.title: Appoint an MAH employee as liaison aware of all correspondence
f.statement: An MAH employee should be appointed as liaison person; this person should be aware of all correspondence, and the liaison's responsibilities should be set out in the contract.
f.clause: Article 7(2)

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibinde çalışan bir personel, irtibat personeli olarak atanmalıdır. Bu personelin; o Tüm yazışmalardan haberi olmalıdır. o Yapılan sözleşmede irtibat personelinin sorumlulukları belirlenmelidir.
rows.location: Article 7(2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive wording, actor (MAH and/or CPVSO) inferred rather than named in the quote. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: A staff member working at the marketing authorisation holder should be appointed as liaison person. This staff member: should be aware of all correspondence; the responsibilities of the liaison person should be set out in the contract made.

f.title: Notify TITCK by official letter of the CPVSO agreement and liaison contact
f.statement: After concluding an agreement with a CPVSO, the MAH should notify TITCK by official letter of this and of the contact details of the person appointed as liaison.
f.clause: Article 7(2)

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibi, bir SFHK ile anlaşma yaptıktan sonra bu durumu ve irtibat personeli olarak görevlendirdiği kişinin iletişim bilgilerini resmi yazı ile Kuruma bildirmelidir.
rows.location: Article 7(2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves level, actor and statement. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: After making an agreement with a CPVSO, the marketing authorisation holder should notify the Agency by official letter of this and of the contact details of the person it has assigned as liaison person.

f.title: Meet the CPVSO QPPV and deputy in advance
f.statement: The MAH should meet and talk in advance with the QPPV and deputy at the CPVSO who will carry out PV activities on its behalf.
f.clause: Article 7(2)

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibi, SFHK’da kendisi adına farmakovijilans faaliyetlerini yürütecek farmakovijilans yetkilisi ve vekili ile önceden tanışmalı ve görüşmelidir.
rows.location: Article 7(2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves level, actor and statement. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder should meet and talk in advance with the pharmacovigilance officer and deputy who will carry out pharmacovigilance activities on its behalf at the CPVSO.

f.title: Obtain a monthly activity report from the CPVSO
f.statement: The MAH should obtain a report every month on the activities performed.
f.clause: Article 7(2)

rows.quote: Her ay yapılan faaliyetler hakkında rapor almalıdır.
rows.location: Article 7(2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: list item quoted without its subject (MAH, from 0057-0059 context). Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: It should receive a report every month on the activities performed.

f.title: CPVSO to share external audit or inspection information with the MAH
f.statement: If the CPVSO undergoes an external audit/inspection, it should share this information with the MAH.
f.clause: Article 7(2)
f.processes: Partner & vendor oversight; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.quote: SFHK, harici bir yoklama/denetim geçirmesi halinde bu bilgiyi ruhsat sahibi ile paylaşmalıdır.
rows.location: Article 7(2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves level, actor and statement. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: If the CPVSO undergoes an external audit/inspection, it should share this information with the marketing authorisation holder.

f.title: Plan termination so the PV system never lapses
f.statement: When the MAH decides to terminate its agreement with the CPVSO, it should plan to set up an in-house PV system or contract a new CPVSO without any interval in which the PV system is not operating.
f.clause: Article 7(2)

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibi, SFHK ile anlaşmasını fesh etmeye karar verdiğinde, arada farmakovijilans sisteminin çalışmadığı bir zaman aralığı oluşmadan, kendi bünyesinde bir farmakovijilans sistemi kurmak ya da yeni bir SFHK ile anlaşmak üzere planlama yapmalıdır.
rows.location: Article 7(2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves level, actor and statement. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When the marketing authorisation holder decides to terminate its agreement with the CPVSO, it should plan to set up an in-house pharmacovigilance system or to make an agreement with a new CPVSO, without an interval arising in which the pharmacovigilance system is not operating.

f.title: Inform TITCK immediately on termination and notify the new QPPV and deputy
f.statement: When the MAH's agreement with the CPVSO ends, the MAH should immediately inform TITCK by official letter and simultaneously notify the new QPPV and deputy who will be responsible for the PV system.
f.clause: Article 7(2)

rows.deadline: Immediately on end of the CPVSO agreement
rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibinin SFHK ile anlaşması sonlandığında ruhsat sahibi Kurumu resmi yazı ile derhal bilgilendirmeli ve eş zamanlı olarak farmakovijilans sisteminden sorumlu olacak yeni farmakovijilans yetkilisi ve vekili bildirilmelidir.
rows.location: Article 7(2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: second clause passive ("bildirilmelidir"); who notifies the new QPPV is inferred as the MAH. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: When the marketing authorisation holder's agreement with the CPVSO ends, the marketing authorisation holder should immediately inform the Agency by official letter, and the new pharmacovigilance officer and deputy who will be responsible for the pharmacovigilance system should be notified simultaneously.

f.title: MAH is responsible for running the controlled access programme successfully
f.statement: Responsibility for running a controlled access programme lies with the MAH, which is obliged to take the measures necessary for the programme to be run successfully.
f.clause: Article 8 Role of the CPVSO in controlled access programmes
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: Kontrollü erişim programının yürütülmesinin sorumluluğu ruhsat sahibindedir. Ruhsat sahibi bu programın başarıyla yürütülmesi için gerekli tedbirleri almakla yükümlüdür.
rows.location: Article 8 Role of the CPVSO in controlled access programmes
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves level, actor and statement. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Responsibility for conducting the controlled access programme lies with the marketing authorisation holder. The marketing authorisation holder is obliged to take the measures necessary for the successful conduct of this programme.

f.title: Contract the dispatching pharmaceutical warehouse with required content
f.statement: In controlled access programmes, the MAH concludes a contract with the pharmaceutical warehouse dispatching the medicine, which must include: the risks of the medicine and problems if it reaches a patient other than the one prescribed; rules to follow from receipt at the warehouse to dispatch to the ordering pharmacy; sanctions for non-compliance; and planning, implementation and reporting of joint measures to improve the process.
f.clause: Article 8(2)
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: Kontrollü erişim programlarında ruhsat sahibi, ilacın çıkışını yaptığı ecza deposu ile bir sözleşme yapar. Bu sözleşmede aşağıdaki hususların yer alması gerekir: a) İlacın riskleri ve reçete edildiği hasta dışında başka bir hastaya ulaşmasının yaratacağı sorunlar b) İlacın ecza deposuna girişi ile siparişin yapıldığı eczaneye gönderilişi sırasında uyulması gereken kurallar c) Bu kurallara uyulmadığı zaman yapılacak yaptırımlar ç) İşleyişin iyileştirilmesi için alınacak ortaklaşa tedbirlerin planlanması, yürütülmesi ve raporlanması.
rows.location: Article 8(2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves level, actor and statement. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In controlled access programmes, the marketing authorisation holder makes a contract with the pharmaceutical warehouse from which the medicine is dispatched. This contract must include the following: a) the risks of the medicine and the problems that would arise if it reached a patient other than the patient for whom it was prescribed; b) the rules to be followed between the receipt of the medicine at the pharmaceutical warehouse and its dispatch to the pharmacy that placed the order; c) the sanctions to be applied when these rules are not followed; ç) the planning, implementation and reporting of joint measures to be taken to improve the operation.

f.title: Train warehouse staff on controlled access programme rules
f.statement: Training is provided so that this information is also known by warehouse staff, including the responsible manager, operations manager and branch manager.
f.clause: Article 8(2)

rows.quote: Bu bilginin ecza deposunun mesul müdürü, operasyon müdürü, şube müdürü de dâhil olmak üzere çalışan personel tarafından da bilinmesi için gerekli eğitimler verilir.
rows.location: Article 8(2)
rows.review_note: Review: Mandatory kept (prescriptive "verilir"); actor (MAH) inferred from context, source is passive. Double-check: below 90: passive "verilir"; MAH actor inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The necessary training is given so that this information is also known by the working staff of the pharmaceutical warehouse, including the responsible manager, the operations manager and the branch manager.

f.title: Controlled access programmes may be run by CPVSOs or third parties
f.statement: A controlled access programme may be run by CPVSOs or by third-party organisations.
f.clause: Article 8(3)
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: Kontrollü erişim programının yürütülmesi SFHK’lar tarafından yapılabileceği gibi, üçüncü kuruluşlar aracılığıyla da yapılabilmektedir.
rows.location: Article 8(3)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: permissive "yapılabilmektedir" with no named actor; MAH framing inferred. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The controlled access programme may be conducted by CPVSOs, and may also be conducted through third-party organisations.

f.title: Do not run the controlled access programme at the CPVSO holding all PV
f.statement: If all PV activities are delegated to a CPVSO, activities within the controlled access programme cannot be carried out by the same CPVSO or by different departments of the same CPVSO, because of personal data confidentiality.
f.clause: Article 8(3)
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: Farmakovijilans faaliyetlerinin tümünün SFHK’ya devredilmesi durumunda kontrollü erişim programı kapsamında yürütülen faaliyetler kişisel verilerin gizliliği nedeniyle aynı SFHK ya da aynı SFHK’nın farklı departmanları tarafından gerçekleştirilemez.
rows.location: Article 8(3)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive prohibition "gerçekleştirilemez"; MAH (who delegates) inferred as actor. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Where all pharmacovigilance activities are delegated to a CPVSO, the activities carried out within the controlled access programme cannot be performed by the same CPVSO or by different departments of the same CPVSO, because of the confidentiality of personal data.

f.title: Transfer all programme data to the new organisation on contract termination
f.statement: If the controlled access programme contract with the MAH is terminated and transferred to another firm, the CPVSO or third party transfers all printed and electronic information to the new organisation contracted by the MAH, with an undertaking that no data remain with it; under no circumstances may this information be given to the MAH or third parties, and the relevant articles of Law No. 6698 apply.
f.clause: Article 8(4)
f.legal_basis: Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: CPVSO or third-party organisation running the controlled access programme
rows.quote: Kontrollü erişim programı dâhilinde yürütülen işlemlerde ruhsat sahipleri ile sözleşmenin feshedilmesi ve başka bir firmaya devredilmesi durumunda SFHK ya da üçüncü firma, sahip olduğu basılı ve elektronik tüm bilgileri kendisinde hiçbir verinin kalmadığı taahhüdüyle ruhsat sahibi firmanın anlaşma yaptığı yeni kuruluşa devreder. Hiçbir durum ve şartta bu bilgiler ruhsat sahibine veya üçüncü kişilere verilemez. Böyle bir durum söz konusu olduğunda 6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu’nun ilgili maddeleri uygulanır.
rows.location: Article 8(4)
rows.review_note: Review: Mandatory confirmed ("devreder", "verilemez"). Double-check: below 90: prescriptive present "devreder"/"verilemez" read as Mandatory. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In operations carried out within a controlled access programme, if the contract with the marketing authorisation holder is terminated and transferred to another company, the CPVSO or third-party company hands over all printed and electronic information it holds to the new organisation with which the marketing authorisation holder company has made an agreement, with an undertaking that no data remains with it. Under no circumstances and conditions may this information be given to the marketing authorisation holder or to third parties. Where such a situation arises, the relevant articles of Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 apply.

f.title: MAH may contract another CPVSO after an agreement ends
f.statement: Following the end of its agreement with a CPVSO, the MAH may conclude an agreement with another CPVSO.
f.clause: Article 9 Transfer of PV activities from one CPVSO to another

rows.quote: Ruhsat sahibi bir SFHK ile anlaşmasının sonlanmasını takiben başka bir SFHK ile anlaşma yapabilir.
rows.location: Article 9 Transfer of PV activities from one CPVSO to another
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves level, actor and statement. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Following the end of its agreement with a CPVSO, the marketing authorisation holder may make an agreement with another CPVSO.

f.title: Transfer PV data completely to the new CPVSO and securely delete at the former
f.statement: In that case, PV data must be transferred completely and accurately to the newly contracted CPVSO, and all data at the first CPVSO deleted by secure deletion.
f.clause: Article 9(1)
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and contract pharmacovigilance service organisation (CPVSO)
rows.quote: Bu durumda farmakovijilans verilerinin tam ve doğru şekilde yeni sözleşme yapılan SFHK’ya devri gerekmekte olup, ilk SFHK’daki tüm verilerin güvenli silme işlemi ile silinmesi gerekmektedir.
rows.location: Article 9(1)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: below 90: passive wording, actor (MAH and/or CPVSO) inferred rather than named in the quote. Bilingual review: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In this case the pharmacovigilance data must be transferred completely and correctly to the newly contracted CPVSO, and all data at the first CPVSO must be deleted by a secure deletion operation.
